supersedes: v2.1 (2026-04-24) — v2.2 adds tissue_arm block with VAL-061 (TIL compartment supplementary) and VAL-062 (tumor cycling-class primary). Blood arm numbers unchanged. v2.1 added full-inline universal_reference block and lessons_learned section. v2.0 initial.

stage_1_immune_flag.rationale: Same universal Stage 1 substrate as the breast card. Buffy coat is approximately 70% immune cells. The Stage 1 measurement is immune-class A-score. Colon cycling epithelium is not in the blood sample at Stage 1.

panel.source_paper: Xu Z, Sandler DP, Taylor JA. J Natl Cancer Inst 2020;112(1):87-94
panel.note: Same Xu-538 panel as breast card. This is deliberate: the panel measures immune-class architectural state; different diseases drive that state in different directions. CRC uses the identical panel as breast but reads the opposite direction as the signature.

stage_1_immune_flag.expected_direction: NEGATIVE (cases depressed below controls — INVERTED from breast)
stage_1_immune_flag.biological_interpretation: Pre-diagnostic CRC drives immune tolerance rather than chronic immune activation. Consistent with Treg expansion and immunosuppressive tumor-microenvironment literature for colorectal disease. The immune-compartment methylation landscape drops below its healthy entropy floor rather than rising above it. Inversion is the signature, not an artifact.

VAL_047_phase12_GSE51032.cohort: GSE51032 EPIC-HuGeF, n=500 usable (76 C18/C19/C20 colorectal cases + 424 controls)
VAL_047_phase12_GSE51032.inversion_verdict: CONFIRMED — direction is negative at every window that meets n≥5, p=0.009 pooled. Inversion is real and is the Stage 1 cross-disease signature distinguishing CRC from breast on the same panel and same cohort.

subtype_stratification_tightening_v2.interpretation: Inversion localizes to colon-proper and rectosigmoid anatomy. Rectum (C20) shows essentially no signal. This is anatomy-specific, consistent with differences in local immune environment and microbiome exposure. Reinforces that the inversion is biological, not a cohort artifact.

zhao_2020_consistency.reference: Zhao et al. 2020 BMC Cancer 20:729 (doi:10.1186/s12885-020-07194-5) on same GSE51032 cohort
zhao_2020_consistency.published_finding: Zhao reports per-CpG directional d = +0.835 on a top-10-CpG panel for colorectal pre-diagnostic detection on this cohort
zhao_2020_consistency.our_consistency_note: Zhao's method is different (top-10-CpG directional score, not immune-class pooled entropy). Zhao detects CRC signal with positive direction using a data-driven panel. Our Stage 1 detects CRC signal with negative direction using the same Xu-538 immune panel that detects breast with positive direction. Both are real; they measure different things. Zhao is a CpG-signature discriminator; ours is an architectural-class drift metric.
zhao_2020_consistency.reference_to_VAL_047_option_3: VAL_047_option3_results.json: CRC top-10-CpG CV d = +0.835 ± 0.093 (n=166 cases vs 424 controls)

URGENT_DEPRESSION.action: Run Stage 2 localization. If colon_epithelial localizes, recommend colonoscopy.

FLOOR_BREACH_DEPRESSION.action: Run Stage 2 localization. Colonoscopy workup regardless of localization.

tier_thresholds_for_negative_direction.IMPORTANT_NOTE: CRC tiering uses depression-from-baseline, not elevation. A CRC patient at age-matched p10 (90% of healthy population scores higher than this patient) is at CRC DETECTABLE tier. Breast tiering uses elevation (≥ p90). Direction is disease-specific.

stage_2_localization.trigger: Stage 1 negative-direction flag at DETECTABLE_DEPRESSION tier or stronger
stage_2_localization.method: Moss 2018 NNLS deconvolution of the same IDAT into 18 per-tissue beta values
stage_2_localization.engine_status: G-DECONV-001 module OPEN-DEFERRED in GitHub roadmap; VAL-041 proved the workflow

crc_specific_expectation.expected_case_beta: approximately 0.610 (drop of 0.13 from healthy, per VAL-041 Moss 2018 Fig 4a data)
crc_specific_expectation.expected_delta_A_at_colon_epithelial: ≥ +0.07 (VAL-041 Colorectal case shows colon_epithelial β = 0.612 vs healthy 0.741, ΔA positive and largest among tested tissues)
crc_specific_expectation.discriminator_vs_other_cancers: CRC: colon_epithelial ΔA elevated; lung_epithelial, gastric_epithelial, bladder_epithelial, hepatocyte, breast_ductal all near healthy. The Stage 1 immune inversion PLUS Stage 2 colon_epithelial localization is the double signature.
crc_specific_expectation.subtype_interpretation: Tightening v2 anatomy split on Stage 1 suggests the immune inversion is strongest for C18 (colon proper) and C19 (rectosigmoid). If Stage 2 localization confirms colon_epithelial and patient's clinical context includes rectal symptoms, weight the anatomy consideration accordingly. Stage 2 deconvolution does not distinguish C18 from C19 from C20 directly — colon_epithelial is one tissue in the Moss atlas.

VAL_041.result: Top-1 localization correct, colon_epithelial β 0.612 vs healthy 0.741 (largest ΔA), all 8 other tissues near healthy
VAL_041.cross_cancer_check: VAL-041 distinguishes colorectal from breast, lung, prostate, HCC, pancreatic, gastric, glioma, bladder, cervical at 10/10 top-1 accuracy

interpretation_rules.if_top1_is_colon_epithelial_and_delta_A_: HIGH-CONFIDENCE CRC localization — crc card fires
interpretation_rules.if_top1_is_colon_epithelial_but_top2_tis: AMBIGUOUS — report both, flag for clinician interpretation
interpretation_rules.if_top1_is_NOT_colon_epithelial: CRC card does NOT fire. The Stage 1 immune inversion combined with a non-colon localization suggests either a non-CRC gastrointestinal condition (inflammatory bowel disease) or a systemic immunosuppressive state. Flag for clinician.
interpretation_rules.if_Stage_1_inversion_present_but_Stage_2: Proceed to Stage 3. Rare pattern; may indicate early-pre-cancer where tumor tissue signal is below NNLS detection threshold.

cross_disease_signature_combining_breast.rationale: Same Xu-538 immune panel on same IDAT gives breast and CRC signals in OPPOSITE directions. Stage 1 immune direction alone is a coarse first-pass classifier BEFORE Stage 2 even runs.

decision_tree_at_Stage_1.immune_A_elevated_above_baseline: Breast-like pattern OR other chronic-immune-activation cancer (lung, prostate per VAL-046 data). Run Stage 2 to localize.
decision_tree_at_Stage_1.immune_A_depressed_below_baseline: CRC-like pattern OR other immunosuppressive cancer. Run Stage 2 to localize.

cross_disease_signature_combining_breast.confidence_caveat: The two-direction signature holds on Phase 9/12 EPIC-Italy cohorts (GSE51057, GSE51032). Cross-population generalization of the CRC inversion direction is not yet validated — no non-EPIC-Italy cohort in CROSS_POPULATION_MANIFEST v1.2 has tested CRC. This is a pending next-step validation.

mandatory_elements: Direction of departure from baseline (elevation / depression / normal)
Tier call applicable to the observed direction
If Stage 2 run: 18-tissue ΔA table with top-3 highlighted, colon_epithelial ΔA explicitly labeled
If CRC Stage 2 fires: anatomy-consideration note (C18 vs C19 vs C20 cannot be distinguished by Stage 2 Moss NNLS; clinical colonoscopy resolves anatomy)
report_contents.language_discipline: Report MUST describe inversion as 'architectural depression below age-matched baseline'. Never 'confirms colorectal cancer' / 'validates diagnosis'. Report is a flag, not a diagnosis.

validation_tier: cross_platform_validated (blood) + cycling_class_tissue_validated (tissue, VAL-062) + compartment_supplementary (VAL-061 TIL reading) + stage_2_only_validated (VAL-041 deconvolution) — first Cookbook card with all three arms independently validated on v2.2

tissue_arm.description: Tissue arm of the CRC card. Uses TCGA-COAD HM450 matched tumor/normal biopsies. Complementary to the blood arm which reads peripheral immune response to CRC. Both arms use the same 26 matched pairs.

cohort.source: TCGA-COAD HM450 via NIH GDC public API
cohort.qc_filter: sample has at least 430 of 538 Xu-538 CpGs with valid beta (0<b<1, not NaN) OR equivalent per-test coverage for VAL-062 genome-wide

arm_primary_VAL062_tumor_architecture_cy.what_it_reads: CRC tumor cell architecture (colon_epithelial = cycling class)
arm_primary_VAL062_tumor_architecture_cy.cpg_subset: all valid HM450 CpGs per sample (tissue biopsy, no deconvolution needed)
arm_primary_VAL062_tumor_architecture_cy.genome_wide_vs_class_specific_note: The 0.02 genome-wide-mean delta_A is smaller than the VAL-001 framework prediction of 0.17 because VAL-001 is calibrated on cycling-class-discriminating CpG subsets while VAL-062 averages all approximately 485K HM450 CpGs. The strong Cohen's d is preserved because between-patient variance is correspondingly small at the genome-wide level. Future cycling-class tissue validations should restrict to cycling-class-informative CpGs to recover the predicted magnitude.
arm_primary_VAL062_tumor_architecture_cy.preregistered_prediction: paired d > 0, 95% CI > 0, d >= +0.5 (strong cycling-class signal)
arm_primary_VAL062_tumor_architecture_cy.outcome_vs_prediction: PASS — all three criteria met; direction confirmed, magnitude strong

comparison_to_prior_tissue_arms.interpretation: CRC cycling tissue comparable to breast secretory tissue, larger than prostate secretory tissue — consistent with CRC higher-proliferation biology driving broader methylation disruption

arm_supplementary_VAL061_tumor_infiltrat.status: SUPPLEMENTARY (TIL compartment reading, not tumor architecture)
arm_supplementary_VAL061_tumor_infiltrat.what_it_reads: Tumor-infiltrating immune cells (TIL) inside the CRC tumor bed — NOT tumor cell architecture

per_cpg_direction.interpretation: 61% hypomethylation is classic CRC global hypomethylation pattern; combined with aggregate positive A-score elevation because H(beta) rises as beta moves toward 0.5 from either direction — Shannon entropy is direction-agnostic

arm_supplementary_VAL061_tumor_infiltrat.interpretation: Xu-538 immune panel on tumor tissue measures immune infiltrate compartment (activated TIL) inside the tumor bed, NOT tumor architecture. TIL are activated and expanded relative to resting peripheral leukocytes — opposite direction from circulating immune response which is suppressed in CRC.
arm_supplementary_VAL061_tumor_infiltrat.reconciliation_with_VAL047_blood: VAL-047 Phase 12 peripheral blood d = -0.33 (suppressed circulating immune response to disease presence). VAL-061 tumor tissue d = +1.07 (activated TIL response inside tumor bed). Same disease, same immune class, opposite-sign readings because the compartment differs. Documented in CCL-019.
arm_supplementary_VAL061_tumor_infiltrat.original_prereg_classification: VAL-061 was originally preregistered as a tumor architecture test predicting d < 0 (inversion-direction). That prereg conflated the immune class (what the Xu-538 panel measures) with the tumor cell class (which is cycling, not immune). The d = +1.07 result is NOT framework inconsistency — it correctly measured the TIL compartment with the immune panel. VAL-062 is the correct tumor architecture test.

three_compartment_CRC_reading_summary.description: CRC produces three distinct EDEAR signal compartments, each with its own expected direction. All three are internally consistent — the framework does not produce a single 'CRC direction' because direction depends on (class, compartment) pair per CCL-019.

compartments.validation: VAL-047 Phase 12 GSE51032 n=76 pre-dx CRC vs 424 controls
compartments.what_it_reads: Circulating immune response suppressed/exhausted in response to disease presence
compartments.clinical_use: Stage 1 pre-diagnostic screen trigger for CRC suspicion

compartments.validation: VAL-041 10/10 correct localization across 10 cancer types
compartments.what_it_reads: CRC cfDNA mathematically extracted from plasma via Moss NNLS
compartments.clinical_use: Stage 2 tissue-of-origin localization when Stage 1 fires

compartments.panel: all available HM450 CpGs (or cycling-class-specific CpGs for higher magnitude)
compartments.validation: VAL-062 TCGA-COAD HM450 matched tumor/normal, n=26 pairs
compartments.what_it_reads: CRC tumor cell architecture disrupted from cycling-class floor
compartments.clinical_use: Post-diagnostic confirmation when biopsy is available; not primary detection

compartments.validation: VAL-061 TCGA-COAD HM450 matched tumor/normal, n=26 pairs
compartments.what_it_reads: Tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes activated and expanded inside tumor bed
compartments.clinical_use: Potential future use for immunotherapy response monitoring; not primary detection

validation_tier_progression.card_wide_tier: cross_platform_validated (blood) + cycling_class_tissue_validated (tissue) + stage_2_only_validated (deconvolution) — first Cookbook card with all three arms independently validated

known_limitations: Only one cohort (GSE51032) has been tested for CRC pre-diagnostic inversion on the Xu-538 panel at the individual-patient level. Cross-cohort replication of the CRC inversion is pending (no other public CRC pre-diagnostic 450K/EPIC cohort has been processed through the identical pipeline yet).
0-2yr and >10yr windows are underpowered (n=8 and n=3 respectively on GSE51032 CRC). The strong pooled result (p=0.009 at n=76) is driven primarily by the 2-5yr and 5-10yr windows.

Xu-538 panel was selected for breast-cancer association in the Sister Study cohort. Its direction on CRC is an emergent finding, not the panel's design target. A CRC-specific purpose-built panel from cycling-class reference tissue would likely produce a larger signal (VAL-048 attempted this but returned null on per-patient SD metric; the panel-selection methodology is reusable but the 450K substrate is insufficient for cycling-class SD resolution).

VAL-048 framework-derived 650-CpG cycling panel on same GSE51032 cohort returned NULL at primary 0-5yr window (d=-0.003, p=0.99). Classified in the Evidence Report as NULL / UNDERPOWERED, not FALSIFICATION. Indicates 450K per-patient SD metric is insufficient for cycling-class resolution; does not contradict the Phase 12 pooled-entropy CRC inversion finding.
Single-timepoint sensitivity at 95% specificity: modest (screening-adjacent, not diagnostic). Deployment is serial-sample trajectory monitoring.
Stage 2 deconvolution production module (G-DECONV-001) is OPEN-DEFERRED — same as breast card.

universal_reference._purpose: Self-contained reference block embedded in every EDEAR disease card. Full-inline Option B: do not rely on README_MASTER or any external file for pipeline invariants. A new analyst loading only this card + GAPE_WEB_v13.py must be able to reproduce the full Stage 1 + Stage 2 + Stage 3 pipeline without reading anything else.

universal_stage_1_pipeline.invariant_rule: Every patient's first test is identical regardless of suspected disease: Stage 1 is always immune-class on buffy-coat DNA using the Xu-538 panel with H_min(immune) = 0.838889. This applies to every EDEAR card. What varies per card: expected direction, Stage 2 tissue target, tier thresholds, mandatory covariates, clinical action paths.
universal_stage_1_pipeline.specimen: buffy coat DNA (peripheral blood leukocytes, ~70% immune cells)
universal_stage_1_pipeline.panel_source_paper: Xu Z, Sandler DP, Taylor JA. JNCI 2020;112(1):87-94
universal_stage_1_pipeline.scoring_method_primary: pooled entropy A-score = mean(H(β)/H_min) across panel
universal_stage_1_pipeline.scoring_method_secondary_for_bidirection: directional A_dir = mean(direction_i × z_i) when disease drives bidirectional per-CpG drift. Applicable to AD via 7-CpG Rule A panel. Other cards use pooled entropy as primary.

universal_h_min_table._note: Class H_min constants from GAPE_WEB_v13.py lines 87-96. Frozen at G-003b MCMC posterior means, R-hat < 1.001. Used at Stage 2 to compute per-tissue A-scores from deconvolved β values.

universal_stage_2_moss_deconvolution.method: Moss 2018 NNLS deconvolution of the Stage 1 IDAT into 18 per-tissue β values
universal_stage_2_moss_deconvolution.production_module_status: G-DECONV-001 OPEN-DEFERRED. VAL-041 proved the workflow at published-β level (10/10 top-1 correct localization across 10 cancer types). Production per-IDAT deployment requires: (1) 30 MB Moss 2018 reference matrix locked into the repo; (2) Salas 2018 QC harness implemented; (3) assay version tag (L1 Illumina EPIC + Moss markers, L2 custom capture panel, L3 full 5-substrate MESA+DELFI).

universal_stage_3_epidish_subcomposition.method: Teschendorff 2017 EpiDISH RPC mode, Salas 2018 reference
universal_stage_3_epidish_subcomposition.when_applied: Runs when Stage 1 flags AND Stage 2 returns no solid-organ localization. Distinguishes chronic inflammation (neutrophil shift), hematologic immune drift (lymphocyte composition shift), autoimmune patterns, AD-type patterns (brain tissue not in buffy coat).
universal_stage_3_epidish_subcomposition.qc_gate_rule: IDATs outside Salas bounds get QC flag; Stage 2 output not released

universal_80_cell_age_baseline_immune_cl._purpose: Age-decade mean and SD of pooled-entropy immune-class A-score in healthy reference cohorts. Used to compute age-matched percentile for Stage 1 tier calls. Applies to every card's NORMAL / MARGINAL / DETECTABLE tier logic.
_sources: Hannum 2013 Mol Cell (GSE40279 blood methylation aging)
Roadmap Epigenomics Consortium 2015 Nature (127 reference epigenomes)
universal_80_cell_age_baseline_immune_cl._critical_caveat_cross_cohort: This baseline is derived from the source cohorts using standard preprocessing (primarily minfi/sesame normalization). Cohorts with different preprocessing pipelines (e.g. Ferrari 2014 GSE53740 with ComBat + quantile normalization) can show cohort-level batch offsets of +2 SD or more relative to this baseline. Example: VAL-057 found GSE53740 HC sit at A_age_z = +2.306 vs this baseline. Any card deployment on a non-AIBL/non-AddNeuroMed cohort requires either (a) re-anchoring to within-cohort HC, or (b) a normalization bridge to the 80-cell scale. Do not assume universal applicability of these constants across preprocessing pipelines.

universal_tier_thresholds._source: 80-cell healthy baseline reference; same across breast-epic, crc-epic, ad-immune, lung-epic
universal_tier_thresholds._note: Per-card tier thresholds MAY deviate from these universals if disease-specific literature justifies. When they deviate, the card MUST cite the deviation explicitly. Silent deviation is forbidden.

NORMAL.action: No action; serial-sample per screening cadence

URGENT.action: Run Stage 2; expedited workup per disease card

FLOOR_BREACH.action: Run Stage 2; urgent clinical workup regardless of localization

universal_sex_stratification_rule.rule: Every card's deployment MUST stratify reports by sex when sex-differential signal has been documented in validation. At v2.1 this applies to ad-immune (VAL-051: female d=+0.71 vs male d=+0.51 AIBL; VAL-057 male recovery, female non-replication in GSE53740). For other cards, sex stratification is recommended in deployment even where no sex-differential has been documented, since absence of evidence is not evidence of absence.
universal_sex_stratification_rule.minimum_reporting: Report must include patient sex. Card scoring MAY differ by sex if documented in validation.

universal_language_discipline.rationale: Every report must present EDEAR output as a flag that changes downstream workup, never as a diagnosis. Final diagnosis requires clinical assessment plus standard-of-care workup (imaging, tissue biopsy, amyloid PET/CSF for AD, etc.) per the relevant clinical guidelines.

universal_cohort_batch_offset_warning.description: VAL-057 established that cohort-level preprocessing artifacts can shift pooled-entropy A-score by +2 SD or more relative to the 80-cell Cookbook baseline. This is a systematic offset, not a biological finding. Applies to any new cohort before its baseline can be used for cross-cohort comparison.
universal_cohort_batch_offset_warning.example: GSE53740 (Ferrari 2014, 450K + ComBat + quantile normalization): HC mean A_age_z = +2.306 vs 80-cell immune baseline.
universal_cohort_batch_offset_warning.deployment_rule: (1) On AIBL or AddNeuroMed-equivalent preprocessing: 80-cell baseline usable directly. (2) On any other cohort: re-anchor to within-cohort HC for tier thresholds OR run a normalization bridge to the 80-cell scale before applying Cookbook tier thresholds.

universal_no_fabrication_rule.rule: Every numeric value, CpG ID, cohort size, validation result, or citation in this card traces to a primary source or a SHA-locked validation run. Nothing is invented or estimated. If a value is a projection or estimate, it is explicitly labeled as such in its field.

lessons_learned._purpose: Disease-specific quirks encountered during validation and deployment.

lessons.quirk: CRC immune A-score direction is INVERTED relative to breast (d=-0.33 all-pre-dx on Xu-538 panel). Same panel, same pipeline, opposite sign. This was surprising on first encounter.
lessons.interpretation: CRC pre-diagnostic immune response is tolerogenic (Treg-dominated, immune-suppressive) rather than activated. The architectural signature is lower entropy drift (more ordered) rather than higher (more disordered) — opposite direction to most cancers. Mechanism aligns with published CRC immune literature on Treg infiltration and immune exclusion.
lessons.applied_to_card: expected_direction in card JSON explicitly flagged as NEGATIVE. Decision logic item 2 in README_MASTER handles this: "depressed below DETECTABLE tier (negative direction) + Stage 2 localizes to colon_epithelial".

lessons.quirk: Near-dx 0-2yr window shows d=-0.47 (even more negative) than all-pre-dx d=-0.33. Direction is preserved and amplified close to diagnosis, not attenuated as in breast.
lessons.interpretation: CRC Treg dominance persists or intensifies close to diagnosis, consistent with published immune-exclusion phenotype of late-stage CRC. Breast (immune escape → attenuation) and CRC (immune suppression → intensification) have structurally different trajectories.
lessons.applied_to_card: known_limitations includes note that CRC and breast have mechanistically opposite pre-dx trajectories; one-size-fits-all interpretation does not work.

lessons.context: Zhao 2020 BMC Cancer published CRC methylation signature
lessons.quirk: Zhao 2020 used a DIFFERENT methodology (classification-trained panel) on the SAME GSE51032 cohort and found CRC-predictive signal. Our inverted-direction finding is consistent with their predictive result — both detect the CRC signal, with different aggregations picking up different aspects.
lessons.interpretation: Cross-methodology consistency on the same cohort supports the finding. Upgrades tier from exploratory to single_cohort_validated_with_consistent_published_reference.
